title: Argentinian Empanada Cabbage Fritters (Italian Twist)
description: A delicious Italian-inspired twist on traditional Argentinian empanadas, featuring crispy cabbage fritters filled with savory cheese and served with a zesty dipping sauce.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, combine flour, cabbage, cheese, milk, eggs, and salt. Mix well.
Shape empanada dough into small balls and flatten slightly.
Place a tablespoon of the cabbage mixture onto the center of each dough round.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Fry the empanada fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with a zesty dipping sauce.
